notes.title: Update Notice: Reinstallation Required for English ver. Launch Issues
notes.content:
Alongside Chinese localization deployment in Build 16898375, this update includes fixes for known English version bugs.



If your game fails to launch after update (Build 16898375):
This may be caused by legacy official patches. Perform these steps:
[olist]
Completely uninstall all game components
→ Delete game folders including supplemental content patches

Clean reinstall via Steam
→ Reinstall base game through Steam Library

Acquire updated content
→ Obtain latest compatible patches through official distribution channels
[/olist]
